title: Maximum Profit Job Scheduling
prompt:
Suppose you have several paid jobs, but you can only work on one at a time. Each job has a start time, an end time, and a payment. Which jobs would you take to earn the most in total?

Write `job_scheduling(start_times, end_times, profits) -> int` to return that maximum payment. The three arrays have the same length, and their entries at index `i` describe one job. Jobs may be given in any order. You can take a job that starts exactly when your previous job ends. If there are no jobs, return `0`.

example.reasoning: Taking the jobs from 1 to 3 and from 3 to 6 yields the best compatible total.
